The technical picture on the XRP price chart aligns with the bullish on-chain data, showing a classic bottoming pattern that could soon resolve to the upside. The price action has formed an inverse head-and-shoulders, a pattern that typically signals a trend reversal from bearish to bullish. The key to this formation is the neckline, which acts as the trigger for the next major move.

XRP is currently trading near $1.13 on the 8-hour chart, just below the crucial neckline of the inverse head-and-shoulders pattern, which is situated around $1.19.
